item.title: Iraq PM sacks nine officials over oil smuggling in pro-Iran stronghold
item.description: Dismissals follow probe that uncovered illegal oil refineries and smuggling in a region run by Kataib Hezbollah.

item.title: Netanyahu sends plea to Eisenkot for unity government
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu has issued a public plea to opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a unity government.

item.title: Thailand’s elderly kept in cages
item.description: A nursing home in Thailand, has been accused of keeping dozens of senior residents, in metal cages.

item.title: SpaceX’s Starship nails a smooth return with historic catch
item.description: SpaceX Starship made a triumphant return to Earth, caught midair by giant mechanical ‘chopsticks’.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza
item.description: Hamas confirms the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an attack on Khan Younis on Saturday.

item.title: Hundreds of men march in Switzerland to protest violence against women
item.description: Organisers say men must speak out, as Swiss study finds half of men aged 18 to 24 hold restrictive view of masculinity.

item.title: SpaceX’s Starship captured by launchpad arms in dramatic first
item.description: SpaceX officials say catch by mechanical arms shows Starship's full reusability, crucial for rapid, low-cost recycling.

item.title: Iran war live: Israel vows Gaza ‘offensive policy’ despite caretaker status
item.description: Israel has pledged to continue its 'offensive policy' on Gaza, as fighting in Yemen grips the region.

item.title: Portugal immortalises Ronaldo with a new number 7
item.description: Portugal’s national team has lined up in Cristiano Ronaldo's number 7 in its first match since he retired from the side.

item.title: Iraq PM targets powerful militia stronghold in $30m oil smuggling probe
item.description: Iraq’s PM has dismissed nine senior security officials over an alleged oil smuggling network worth up to $30m monthly.

item.title: Netanyahu says only a unity government can guarantee Israel’s security
item.description: Eisenkot, in charge of forming a government, dismisses the appeal as ‘tricks’ as talks and a Knesset speaker vote loom.

item.title: Explosion near Syria’s capital kills father and child
item.description: Syria’s Internal Security Forces have launched an investigation into a suspected bomb attack in a suburb of Damascus.

item.title: Palestinian stories set for major presence at 2027 Oscars
item.description: Al Jazeera spoke to the director and cast of Who Is Still Alive, Switzerland’s Oscar entry for Best International Film.

item.title: Ronaldo-less Portugal thrashed 4-1 by Denmark in the Nations League
item.description: Rasmus Hojlund stars with brace as Denmark close in on a spot in the Nations League quarterfinals.

item.title: US flights resume after ageing technology blamed for outage
item.description: US flights resume after ageing technology blamed for outage

item.title: US envoy Kushner says he aims to broker Europe-Russia talks on Ukraine
item.description: Europe's direct engagement with Moscow as part of Ukraine-Russia peace talks is edging closer to becoming a reality.

item.title: India’s Assam state demolishes homes of 132 Muslim families
item.description: Authorities in India’s Assam have demolished the homes of 132 Muslim families.

item.title: Can being ‘non-Western’ cost you your home in Denmark?
item.description: Denmark’s Supreme Court is set to rule on whether families can be forced from their homes under a law.

item.title: Deadly car bomb blast kills two near Syria’s capital
item.description: At least two people, a man and a girl, have been killed in a car bomb blast in Jaramana, near Syria's capital Damascus.

item.title: More than 100,000 rally across France in new Yellow Vest protests
item.description: Protesters chanted against declining affordability, the Macron government, police violence and poor school conditions.

item.title: Tens of thousands march in latest Portugal housing protests
item.description: These were the biggest protests against rising housing costs in Portugal since the social movement began weeks ago.

item.title: Pope Leo urges end to violence in Peru during visit to remote Andes town
item.description: In Santa Cruz de Succhabamba, the pope told people not to respond to injustice with brutality.

item.description: US blames outdated technology for nationwide flight disruption

item.title: US blames system upgrade for longest nationwide FAA ground stop since 9/11
item.description: Sean Duffy, the country's transportation secretary, said his agency is 'going to hold people accountable'.

item.title: Rising costs and arrests fuel protests in Central African Republic
item.description: Hundreds take to the streets of Bangui to protest rising fuel prices and arrests in the Central African Republic.
